title: Find an apartment that fits your must-have list
summary: Tell ChatGPT your budget, area, pets and must-haves, and a rental app inside it (Apartments.com, Zumper, RentCafe or Apartment List) searches live listings, compares them side by side and can request a tour.
problem: Apartment hunting means checking several rental sites, re-entering the same filters, and losing track of which places allow your dog, include laundry or are actually available when you need to move.
outcome: A short list of real, currently listed apartments that match your must-haves, compared on rent, fees and pet rules, with tours requested only for the ones you pick.
what_the_bot_does: Write down your must-haves before you start: city or ZIP code, top rent, bedrooms, move-in date, pets, and one or two features you won't give up, like parking or in-unit laundry.
In ChatGPT, open Apps, connect a rental app such as Apartments.com, Zumper, RentCafe or Apartment List, then type @ and the app's name before your request so it searches that site's live listings.
Paste the prompt below. Change one thing at a time (price, area, a feature) so you can see what each trade-off costs you.
Ask it to compare your favorites side by side on rent, required fees, pet rules and move-in date, and to give you the link to each full listing.
Request tours or message the property only for the places you choose, and check every detail on the listing site and in person before you apply or pay anything.
what_you_end_up_with: A short list of real, currently listed apartments that match your must-haves, compared on rent, fees and pet rules, with tours requested only for the ones you pick.
prompt:
I'm looking for a place to rent. Here's my list:

Area: [city, neighborhood or ZIP code]
Top monthly rent: [e.g. $1,800]
Bedrooms: [e.g. 2]
Move-in date: [e.g. around March 1]
Pets: [e.g. one 50 lb dog]
Must-haves: [e.g. in-unit laundry, parking]
Nice to have: [e.g. near a grocery store, a balcony]

Search current listings and show me up to 8 that meet every must-have. Put them in a table with the address or building name, rent, required monthly and move-in fees, pet rules and fees, move-in availability, and a link to the full listing. Say clearly if any detail isn't shown in the listing instead of guessing. Then tell me which must-have, if any, is ruling out the most places. Don't contact anyone or book a tour until I tell you which ones.
watch_out: Listings can be out of date or wrong. Confirm rent, fees and availability on the listing site and with the property before you apply.

Rental scams copy real listings. Never pay a deposit or fee for a place you haven't seen, and never pay by wire, gift card, crypto or a payment app. The FTC says to search the address for duplicate listings and call the company's own number.
Don't share your Social Security number, ID or pay stubs in the chat or with a landlord until you've agreed to rent from a company you've checked out.
Each app only shows its own site's listings, so a place listed elsewhere won't appear. Try a second app if results are thin.

faq.q: Can ChatGPT find apartments for rent?
faq.a: Yes. Rental apps inside ChatGPT, such as Apartments.com, Zumper, RentCafe and Apartment List, search their live listings when you describe what you need. Connect one under Apps, then type @ and its name before your request.

faq.q: Can AI book an apartment tour for me?
faq.a: The Apartments.com app in ChatGPT can message a property manager or request or book a tour, and RentCafe lets you request a tour from a listing. Ask it to act only on the places you pick, and check the listing yourself before you pay anything.
